messages:
Rae: Quick spot from the dashboard review: compact rows look misaligned when legend wraps and the axis unit shows 'ms' in tiny type. Also, smoothing hides spikes too aggressively in previews. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/compact-legend-issue.png

Omar: Agreed. Two separate fixes: 1) force single-line legend truncation with an ellipsis; 2) indicate out-of-bounds peaks rather than smoothing them away in the mini view.

Sam (Design): For the legend truncation I'd prefer a tooltip that is keyboard-accessible — not just title attr. Tooltip copy draft: "Series: API latency 0 peak 1.8s at 11:02 UTC 0 unit: p95 (ms)". Screen reader hint: "press Enter to reveal details."

Tess (Eng): Implementation: CSS text-overflow for truncation, plus an explicit tooltip component for hover/focus. For outliers we'll render a faint vertical indicator at the preview edge and expose a popup with peak/time. That avoids per-row autoscale which breaks comparison.

Rae: Accessibility nit: ensure the spike indicator meets 3:1 contrast, and the popup is reachable by keyboard without changing tab order.

a11y-bot: reminder: marker should use aria-describedby referencing popup content; tooltip must appear on focus and be announced by SR.

Sam (Design): Decision proposal: ship single-line legend truncation + accessible tooltip, add edge outlier indicator + keyboard popup; defer per-row autoscale and smoothing changes to v-next. I'll write the microcopy and a11y spec.

Tess (Eng): I'll prototype the SVG marker + tooltip aria linkage. Will post a demo link here when ready.

Omar: Also: tiny axis unit ambiguity 0 suggestion: show a small unit badge (absolute-positioned) in the row that reveals full unit on hover, and move unit into header on very narrow widths.

Sam (Design): Good call. Add that to the spec. Action items: Sam 0 a11y copy & spec; Tess 0 spike branch; Omar 0 small-screen mock. Target: prototype by Thursday EOD.

Rae: Thanks team :thumbsup:
